prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: diffuse colour material image for a luxury contemporary Xiangqi board, paired with pale milky jade-grey celadon ceramic pieces.
Primary request: One uninterrupted carefully planed warm medium-light walnut-style timber surface, seen strictly straight down. Fine close quarter-sawn grain runs vertically from bottom to top. Sophisticated quiet amber-brown wood, mean sRGB approximately #bb946e, narrow gently undulating darker growth lines, almost invisible pores. Gentle realistic natural variation; grain much finer and calmer than oak or pine. No knots, no seams, no planks, no rings, no dark streaks, no high-contrast grain.
Composition: one square filled edge to edge with the continuous wood surface, orthographic top-down, no perspective, no object edges, no frame, no surrounding scene. The visible area represents about50cm by50cm. This is a game-board base-colour reference: NO grid, NO lettering, NO river, NO symbols, NO pieces, NO borders or ornament.
Lighting: flat neutral diffuse illumination, even exposure across entire square. No cast shadows, specular highlights, vignette, baked reflections or directional light. Smooth satin planed timber with understated fine detail. Keep the surface light enough for dark brown playing lines to remain readable and warm enough for pale green-white pieces to stand out. No orange saturation, grey weathering or plastic.
Output: one opaque square photographic material image at high resolution, no transparency, labels or watermark.
